es_es.title: Another Furniture: detalles de casa
es_es.subtitle: Porque un cuarto nunca está terminado.
text: [lead] Sillas que se meten bajo la mesa, cortinas que se mueven, sofás en 16 colores.
[li] [item:another_furniture:furniture_hammer|Martillo]: dos tablones, una losa y dos palos; cambia el estilo de algunas piezas ya puestas.
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_table|Mesa de roble]: tres tablones sobre dos palos dan [hl|3].
{page}
[li] Las sillas se meten bajo la mesa y vuelven a salir.
Sillas, estantes, mesas, postigos, maceteros, bancos y cajones en 11 maderas; sofás, taburetes, cortinas y lámparas en los 16 colores.

en_us.title: Sofas, Lamps and Drawers
en_us.subtitle: Wool is the whole idea.
text: [lead] Soft seating and a wool lamp, in every color.
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_sofa|White Sofa]: two planks, three wool and two sticks make [hl|3].
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_stool|White Stool]: [hl|3] from two planks, a wool and two sticks; the tall stool adds three more sticks.
{page}
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_lamp|White Lamp]: a torch wrapped in wool on a stick, [hl|3].
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_drawer|Oak Drawer]: six planks, two slabs and a stick; it opens as a real container.
[li] [item:another_furniture:service_bell|Service Bell]: an iron nugget over three iron ingots make [hl|3].

es_es.title: Sofás, lámparas y cajones
es_es.subtitle: La lana es toda la idea.
text: [lead] Asientos blandos y una lámpara de lana, en todos los colores.
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_sofa|Sofá blanco]: dos tablones, tres lanas y dos palos dan [hl|3].
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_stool|Taburete blanco]: [hl|3] con dos tablones, una lana y dos palos; el taburete alto suma tres palos más.
{page}
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_lamp|Lámpara blanca]: una antorcha envuelta en lana sobre un palo, [hl|3].
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_drawer|Cajón de roble]: seis tablones, dos losas y un palo; abre como un contenedor de verdad.
[li] [item:another_furniture:service_bell|Campana de servicio]: una pepita de hierro sobre tres lingotes dan [hl|3].

en_us.title: Curtains, Shutters and Flower Boxes
en_us.subtitle: A window with something to say.
text: [lead] Dress the window from the inside and the outside.
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_curtain|White Curtain]: two sticks over four wool make [hl|3]; they slide with a click.
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_shutter|Oak Shutter]: six slabs make [hl|4].
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_flower_box|Oak Flower Box]: two slabs, dirt and three planks make [hl|3].

es_es.title: Cortinas, postigos y maceteros
es_es.subtitle: Una ventana con algo que decir.
text: [lead] Vestí la ventana por dentro y por fuera.
[li] [item:another_furniture:white_curtain|Cortina blanca]: dos palos sobre cuatro lanas dan [hl|3]; se corren con un clic.
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_shutter|Contraventana de roble]: seis losas dan [hl|4].
[li] [item:another_furniture:oak_flower_box|Macetero de roble]: dos losas, tierra y tres tablones dan [hl|3].

en_us.title: Where you can sit
en_us.subtitle: Purely cosmetic. Entirely necessary.
text: [lead] Handcrafted and Another Furniture seats take you with an empty hand.
[icon:right_click] Right-click a chair, bench, stool or couch to sit; sneak to stand up.
[note] Nothing here gives a bonus. It is for co-op evenings and screenshots.

es_es.title: Dónde sentarse
es_es.subtitle: Puramente estético. Totalmente necesario.
text: [lead] Los asientos de Handcrafted y Another Furniture te reciben con la mano vacía.
[icon:right_click] Clic derecho sobre una silla, banco, taburete o sillón para sentarte; agachate para pararte.
[note] Acá nada da bonificaciones. Es para las noches de coop y las capturas.

en_us.title: One role per set
text: [note] Each furniture set has a job: Handcrafted for classics, Refurbished Furniture for working appliances, Another Furniture for cozy details and Storage Delight for kitchen storage.
Macaw's Furniture stayed out: a third palette with nothing new to do.

es_es.title: Un oficio por juego
text: [note] Cada juego de muebles tiene su oficio: Handcrafted para los clásicos, Refurbished Furniture para los aparatos que funcionan, Another Furniture para los detalles de casa y Storage Delight para guardar en la cocina.
Macaw's Furniture quedó afuera: una tercera paleta sin nada nuevo que hacer.

en_us.title: Refurbished Furniture: Appliances
en_us.subtitle: Furniture with a plug.
text: [lead] Furniture built at its own powered workbench.
[big|471] pieces to build.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:workbench|Workbench]: a stonecutter, a redstone block, an iron ingot, planks and slabs.
[li] It lists [hl|444] constructions and pulls materials from your inventory, its own storage and the chests beside it.
{page}
[li] Tables, chairs, desks, sofas, cabinets, beds, hedges and lights, in wood and in color.

es_es.title: Refurbished Furniture: aparatos
es_es.subtitle: Muebles con enchufe.
text: [lead] Muebles armados en su propio banco con electricidad.
[big|471] piezas para armar.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:workbench|Banco de trabajo]: un cortapiedras, un bloque de redstone, un lingote de hierro, tablones y losas.
[li] Lista [hl|444] construcciones y saca los materiales de tu inventario, de su propio almacén y de los cofres de al lado.
{page}
[li] Mesas, sillas, escritorios, sofás, gabinetes, camas, setos y luces, en madera y en color.

en_us.title: Electricity for Your Home
en_us.subtitle: Check the cable before the fuse.
text: [lead] A small grid of its own: fuel a generator and link the devices with a wrench.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:light_electricity_generator|Light Electricity Generator]: seven iron ingots, a redstone block and a blast furnace.
{page}
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:wrench|Wrench]: link one node, then the other. Three iron ingots, two strings and leather.
Defaults: power reaches [hl|80] blocks around the generator; a device takes [hl|6] links, a generator [hl|12] and a network [hl|64] devices.
[careful] A screen that says missing power is not linked to a running generator.

es_es.title: Electricidad para tu casa
es_es.subtitle: Mirá el cable antes que el fusible.
text: [lead] Una red chica propia: cargá combustible en un generador y unilo a los aparatos con una llave.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:light_electricity_generator|Generador eléctrico claro]: siete lingotes de hierro, un bloque de redstone y un alto horno.
{page}
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:wrench|Llave inglesa]: unís un nodo y después el otro. Tres lingotes de hierro, dos hilos y cuero.
Por defecto: la energía llega a [hl|80] bloques alrededor del generador; un aparato admite [hl|6] enlaces, un generador [hl|12] y una red [hl|64] aparatos.
[careful] Una pantalla que dice sin energía no está unida a un generador encendido.

en_us.title: The Working Kitchen
en_us.subtitle: Every appliance, its own recipes.
text: [lead] Fridge, freezer, stove, oven, microwave, toaster and cutting board, each with recipes of its own.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:light_fridge|Light Fridge]: nine iron, three copper and four redstone at the workbench.
[li] The freezer makes [item:minecraft:blue_ice|Blue Ice] from packed ice in [hl|2] minutes.
{page}
[li] Oven and microwave bake a potato in [hl|10] seconds; toaster and pan make a cheese toastie in [hl|20].
[li] The cutting board slices with [hl|41] recipes and combines with [hl|6].

es_es.title: La cocina que anda
es_es.subtitle: Cada aparato, sus propias recetas.
text: [lead] Heladera, freezer, cocina, horno, microondas, tostadora y tabla de cortar, cada uno con recetas propias.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:light_fridge|Heladera clara]: nueve de hierro, tres de cobre y cuatro de redstone en el banco.
[li] El freezer hace [item:minecraft:blue_ice|Hielo azul] de hielo compacto en [hl|2] minutos.
{page}
[li] Horno y microondas hornean una papa en [hl|10] segundos; tostadora y sartén hacen un tostado de queso en [hl|20].
[li] La tabla de cortar corta con [hl|41] recetas y combina con [hl|6].

en_us.title: Screens and HomeControl
en_us.subtitle: The smart home, minus the app store.
text: [lead] A television, a computer and lights you switch from a program.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:television|Television]: eight iron, two copper, a glass, sixteen redstone and two amethyst shards.
{page}
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:computer|Computer]: twelve iron, three copper, a glass, twenty-four redstone and two amethyst shards.
[li] HomeControl turns the power of any device on the same network on and off; rename devices on an anvil first.

es_es.title: Pantallas y HomeControl
es_es.subtitle: La casa inteligente, sin tienda de apps.
text: [lead] Un televisor, una computadora y luces que prendés desde un programa.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:television|Televisor]: ocho de hierro, dos de cobre, un cristal, dieciséis de redstone y dos fragmentos de amatista.
{page}
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:computer|Computadora]: doce de hierro, tres de cobre, un cristal, veinticuatro de redstone y dos fragmentos de amatista.
[li] HomeControl prende y apaga cualquier aparato de la misma red; ponele nombre a los aparatos en un yunque antes.

en_us.title: Mail Between Players
en_us.subtitle: The friendliest way to share.
text: [lead] Send a package to any mailbox on the server, no meetup needed.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:post_box|Post Box]: ten iron, eight planks and a blue dye at the workbench.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_mail_box|Oak Mailbox]: eight planks, the receiving end.
{page}
[li] Pick a mailbox from the list (search players with @), load the slots, add a message and send.

es_es.title: Correo entre jugadores
es_es.subtitle: La forma más amable de compartir.
text: [lead] Mandá un paquete a cualquier buzón del servidor, sin juntarse.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:post_box|Buzón postal]: diez de hierro, ocho tablones y un tinte azul en el banco.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_mail_box|Buzón de roble]: ocho tablones, el lado que recibe.
{page}
[li] Elegí un buzón de la lista (buscá jugadores con @), cargá los casilleros, sumá un mensaje y mandá.

en_us.title: The Bathroom and the Garden
en_us.subtitle: Every house needs one. Even this one.
text: [lead] Toilet, basin and bath, in [hl|26] materials.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_toilet|Oak Toilet]: three planks, five quartz blocks, iron and copper at the workbench.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_bath|Oak Bath]: five planks and eight quartz blocks make the tub.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_basin|Oak Basin]: the sink.
{page}

Out the back door: [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_hedge|Oak Hedge] (six leaves at the workbench), lattice fences and gates in ten woods, five kinds of stepping stones and a [item:refurbished_furniture:white_trampoline|White Trampoline] (four iron, eight string, a white dye and a slime ball).

es_es.title: El baño y el jardín
es_es.subtitle: Toda casa necesita uno. Hasta esta.
text: [lead] Inodoro, lavatorio y bañera, en [hl|26] materiales.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_toilet|Inodoro de roble]: tres tablones, cinco bloques de cuarzo, hierro y cobre en el banco.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_bath|Bañera de roble]: cinco tablones y ocho bloques de cuarzo hacen la bañera.
[li] [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_basin|Lavatorio de roble]: el lavatorio.
{page}

Por la puerta de atrás: [item:refurbished_furniture:oak_hedge|Seto de roble] (seis hojas en el banco), vallas y portones de enrejado en diez maderas, cinco tipos de piedras de paso y una [item:refurbished_furniture:white_trampoline|Cama elástica blanca] (cuatro de hierro, ocho hilos, un tinte blanco y una bola de slime).

en_us.title: Heavy furniture stays
text: [tip] Carry On refuses kitchen blocks, Farmer's Delight blocks and Sophisticated and Functional storage, on purpose.
Break and replace them, or use Packing Tape on Sophisticated chests.
Plain chests, barrels and furnaces still travel.

es_es.title: El mueble pesado se queda
text: [tip] Carry On rechaza los bloques de cocina, los de Farmer's Delight y el almacenamiento de Sophisticated y Functional, a propósito.
Rompelos y volvé a ponerlos, o usá cinta de embalar en los cofres de Sophisticated.
Los cofres comunes, barriles y hornos siguen viajando.

en_us.title: FramedBlocks: Any Texture
en_us.subtitle: An empty frame with opinions.
text: [lead] Every shape wears the texture of whatever block you give it.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_cube|Framed Cube]: four planks and four sticks make [hl|4].
[li] [icon:right_click] Right-click a placed frame with any block: a copper sloped roof, a stone door.
{page}
[li] [hl|200+] shapes: slabs, stairs, panels, slopes, corners, doors, fences and more.
[careful] Blocks with block entities, and non-solid blocks, cannot be used as a camo.

es_es.title: FramedBlocks: cualquier textura
es_es.subtitle: Un marco vacío con opiniones.
text: [lead] Cada forma se pone la textura del bloque que le des.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_cube|Cubo enmarcado]: cuatro tablones y cuatro palos dan [hl|4].
[li] [icon:right_click] Clic derecho sobre un marco puesto con cualquier bloque: un techo inclinado de cobre, una puerta de piedra.
{page}
[li] [hl|200+] formas: losas, escaleras, paneles, pendientes, esquinas, puertas, vallas y más.
[careful] Los bloques con entidad de bloque y los no sólidos no sirven de camuflaje.

en_us.title: The Framing Saw
en_us.subtitle: Every shape, one saw.
text: [lead] Lists every frame shape and cuts the one you pick from cubes.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framing_saw|Framing Saw]: an iron ingot over three framed cubes.
[li] A cube is worth [hl|6,144] material, a slab [hl|3,072], a chest [hl|24,576].
{page}
[li] The [item:framedblocks:powered_framing_saw|Powered Framing Saw] runs on energy: two redstone dust, an iron ingot and three cubes.
[tip] When a shape needs too much at once, cut a smaller block first and use it as the intermediate step. A mode of the saw even encodes AE2 patterns.

es_es.title: La sierra de marcos
es_es.subtitle: Todas las formas, una sierra.
text: [lead] Lista cada forma de marco y corta la que elegís a partir de cubos.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framing_saw|Sierra de marcos]: un lingote de hierro sobre tres cubos enmarcados.
[li] Un cubo vale [hl|6,144] de material, una losa [hl|3,072], un cofre [hl|24,576].
{page}
[li] La [item:framedblocks:powered_framing_saw|Sierra de marcos eléctrica] anda con energía: dos polvos de redstone, un lingote de hierro y tres cubos.
[tip] Cuando una forma pide demasiado de una, cortá primero un bloque más chico y usalo de paso intermedio. Un modo de la sierra hasta codifica patrones de AE2.

en_us.title: Framed Tools and Tricks
en_us.subtitle: Wrench, hammer, axe and blueprint.
text: [lead] The tools that finish a frame: rotate, toggle, keep the camo, copy.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_wrench|Framed Wrench]: rotates and configures (slope faces, split lines, one-way windows). Two cubes and two sticks.
{page}
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_hammer|Framed Hammer]: toggles waterlogging, copycat style and trapdoor texture rotation.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_axe|Framed Axe]: frames it breaks keep their camo.

[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_blueprint|Framed Blueprint]: copies a frame with its camo and places copies from your materials; [item:framedblocks:framed_reinforcement|Framed Reinforcement] marks one as reinforced.
[note] The [item:framedblocks:framed_glowing_cube|Framed Glowing Cube] takes a cube and four glowstone dust.

es_es.title: Herramientas y trucos de marcos
es_es.subtitle: Llave, martillo, hacha y plano.
text: [lead] Las herramientas que terminan un marco: girar, alternar, conservar el camuflaje, copiar.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_wrench|Llave de marcos]: gira y configura (caras de pendiente, líneas de corte, ventanas de un solo sentido). Dos cubos y dos palos.
{page}
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_hammer|Martillo de marcos]: alterna el anegado, el estilo copycat y el giro de textura de las trampillas.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_axe|Hacha de marcos]: los marcos que rompe conservan su camuflaje.

[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_blueprint|Plano de marcos]: copia un marco con su camuflaje y pone copias con tus materiales; [item:framedblocks:framed_reinforcement|Refuerzo de marcos] marca uno como reforzado.
[note] El [item:framedblocks:framed_glowing_cube|Cubo enmarcado luminoso] lleva un cubo y cuatro polvos de piedra luminosa.

en_us.title: One-Way Window
en_us.subtitle: You see out. They see the wall.
text: [lead] Glass that is see-through from one side only.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_one_way_window|Framed One-Way Window]: four tinted glass and four cubes make [hl|4].
[li] Hit it with a [item:framedblocks:framed_wrench|Framed Wrench] to set the see-through side; crouch to clear it.

es_es.title: Ventana de un solo sentido
es_es.subtitle: Vos ves afuera. Ellos ven la pared.
text: [lead] Vidrio que se ve a través desde un solo lado.
[li] [item:framedblocks:framed_one_way_window|Ventana enmarcada de un solo sentido]: cuatro cristales tintados y cuatro cubos dan [hl|4].
[li] Golpeala con una [item:framedblocks:framed_wrench|Llave de marcos] para fijar el lado transparente; agachado lo borrás.

en_us.title: LittleTiles: Inside a Block
en_us.subtitle: The block was always too big.
text: [lead] Build with pieces much smaller than a block.
[li] [item:littletiles:chisel|Little Chisel]: two iron ingots over a lapis places shapes.
[li] [item:littletiles:hammer|Little Hammer]: three iron ingots and two lapis; it carves shapes back out.
[li] [item:littletiles:bag|Little Bag]: holds your materials and colors.
{page}
Press [key:key.little.config.item] with a tool in hand to set the grid size and the shape, and [key:key.little.undo] to take a step back.

es_es.title: LittleTiles: dentro de un bloque
es_es.subtitle: El bloque siempre fue demasiado grande.
text: [lead] Construí con piezas mucho más chicas que un bloque.
[li] [item:littletiles:chisel|Cincel diminuto]: dos lingotes de hierro sobre un lapislázuli coloca formas.
[li] [item:littletiles:hammer|Martillo diminuto]: tres lingotes de hierro y dos lapislázuli; vuelve a tallar las formas.
[li] [item:littletiles:bag|Bolsa diminuta]: guarda tus materiales y colores.
{page}
Apretá [key:key.little.config.item] con una herramienta en la mano para fijar el tamaño de la grilla y la forma, y [key:key.little.undo] para dar un paso atrás.

en_us.title: Glove, Saw and Wrench
en_us.subtitle: Nudge a tile. Then nudge it back.
text: [lead] Move what you placed instead of breaking it.
[li] [item:littletiles:glove|Little Glove]: four leather around a lapis; picks a block, selects a shape, moves corners.
[li] [item:littletiles:saw|Little Saw]: extends or shrinks a tile.
[li] [item:littletiles:wrench|Little Wrench]: rebuilds the block cache and shows signals.

es_es.title: Guante, sierra y llave
es_es.subtitle: Empujá una pieza. Después empujala de vuelta.
text: [lead] Mové lo que pusiste en vez de romperlo.
[li] [item:littletiles:glove|Guante diminuto]: cuatro cueros alrededor de un lapislázuli; elige un bloque, selecciona una forma, mueve esquinas.
[li] [item:littletiles:saw|Sierra diminuta]: alarga o achica una pieza.
[li] [item:littletiles:wrench|Llave diminuta]: reconstruye la caché del bloque y muestra las señales.

en_us.title: Paint and Bottles
en_us.subtitle: Each tile picks its own color.
text: [lead] Color any tile, one at a time.
[li] [item:littletiles:paint_brush|Little Paint Brush]: three white wool over two lapis.
[li] Dyeable blocks (clean, floor, brick, stone, sand, water and more) take the color.
[li] Bottles of black, cyan, magenta, yellow and alpha hold a color; a glass makes an alpha bottle.

es_es.title: Pintura y botellas
es_es.subtitle: Cada pieza elige su color.
text: [lead] Coloreá cualquier pieza, de a una.
[li] [item:littletiles:paint_brush|Pincel diminuto]: tres lanas blancas sobre dos lapislázuli.
[li] Los bloques teñibles (limpio, piso, ladrillo, piedra, arena, agua y más) toman el color.
[li] Las botellas de negro, cian, magenta, amarillo y alfa guardan un color; un cristal hace una botella alfa.

en_us.title: LittleTiles Doors
en_us.subtitle: A bookshelf that is also a door.
text: [lead] Save a selection as a structure and some structures move.
[li] [item:littletiles:blueprint|Little Blueprint]: seven paper around a lapis and redstone make [hl|4].
[li] Doors slide or rotate by the distance and angle you choose, and can open with a right-click.
{page}
[note] A secret bookshelf door made of tiny pieces is a rite of passage.

es_es.title: Puertas de LittleTiles
es_es.subtitle: Una biblioteca que además es puerta.
text: [lead] Guardá una selección como estructura y algunas estructuras se mueven.
[li] [item:littletiles:blueprint|Plano diminuto]: siete papeles alrededor de un lapislázuli y redstone dan [hl|4].
[li] Las puertas se deslizan o giran según la distancia y el ángulo que elijas, y pueden abrirse con clic derecho.
{page}
[note] Una puerta secreta de biblioteca hecha con piezas diminutas es un rito de iniciación.

en_us.title: Signals
en_us.subtitle: Redstone, but tiny.
text: [lead] Tiny inputs, outputs and cables that carry 1, 4 or 16 signals.
[li] [item:littletiles:signal_converter|Signal Converter]: a redstone block over a cobblestone.
[li] Clock and daylight sensors, displays and cables are premade structures you craft from ordinary ingredients.
{page}
[li] With the [item:littletiles:wrench|Little Wrench] in hand you see the signals and can edit a structure's signals.

es_es.title: Señales
es_es.subtitle: Redstone, pero diminuta.
text: [lead] Entradas, salidas y cables diminutos que llevan 1, 4 o 16 señales.
[li] [item:littletiles:signal_converter|Conversor de señales]: un bloque de redstone sobre un adoquín.
[li] Los sensores de reloj y de luz de día, las pantallas y los cables son estructuras prehechas que fabricás con ingredientes comunes.
{page}
[li] Con la [item:littletiles:wrench|Llave diminuta] en la mano ves las señales y podés editar las de una estructura.

en_us.title: Tiny tiles cost frames
text: [tip] Every LittleTiles block can hold a lot of geometry, and your graphics card pays for it.
The server cost is not distinguishable from noise; how much the client pays is not measured yet.
Use it for statues, furniture and signs. For big surfaces, FramedBlocks or Copycats.

es_es.title: Las piezas diminutas cuestan cuadros
text: [tip] Cada bloque de LittleTiles puede guardar mucha geometría, y la paga tu placa de video.
El costo en el servidor no se distingue del ruido; cuánto paga el cliente todavía no está medido.
Usalo para estatuas, muebles y carteles. Para superficies grandes, FramedBlocks o Copycats.

en_us.title: Glass That Does Things
en_us.subtitle: Walk through the shop window.
text: [lead] Ghostly, ethereal and reverse glass: windows you can walk through.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_ghostly|Ghostly Glass]: four glass and an ender pearl make [hl|4]; entities pass through.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_ethereal|Ethereal Glass]: with an ender eye instead; players pass, mobs do not.
{page}
[li] The reverse version does the opposite: only players are stopped.
Dark ethereal glass blocks light: eight tinted glass and an ender eye make [hl|8]. Glass doors, trapdoors and panes come in each kind.

es_es.title: Vidrios que hacen cosas
es_es.subtitle: Atravesá la vidriera.
text: [lead] Vidrio fantasmal, etéreo e inverso: ventanas que se atraviesan.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_ghostly|Cristal espectral]: cuatro cristales y una perla de Ender dan [hl|4]; las entidades lo atraviesan.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_ethereal|Cristal etéreo]: con un ojo de Ender; los jugadores pasan, los monstruos no.
{page}
[li] La versión inversa hace lo contrario: sólo frena a los jugadores.
El vidrio etéreo oscuro bloquea la luz: ocho cristales tintados y un ojo de Ender dan [hl|8]. Puertas, trampillas y paneles de vidrio vienen en cada tipo.

en_us.title: Glass with Light and Signal
en_us.subtitle: Windows that glow, windows that talk.
text: [lead] Light glass shines, redstone glass shouts.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_light|Luminous Glass]: eight glass around a glowstone make [hl|8]; it emits light.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_redstone|Redstone Glass]: eight glass around a redstone block make [hl|8]; it emits a redstone signal.
See the wiring through the wall without opening it.

es_es.title: Vidrio con luz y señal
es_es.subtitle: Ventanas que brillan, ventanas que hablan.
text: [lead] El vidrio de luz brilla, el de redstone avisa.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_light|Cristal luminoso]: ocho cristales alrededor de una piedra luminosa dan [hl|8]; emite luz.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_redstone|Cristal de redstone]: ocho cristales alrededor de un bloque de redstone dan [hl|8]; emite una señal de redstone.
Mirá el cableado a través de la pared sin abrirla.

en_us.title: One-Way Glass
en_us.subtitle: A secret window, a very polite one.
text: [lead] Transparent from one side, solid from the other.
[li] [item:glassential:one_way_glass|One Way Glass]: six glass, an observer and a black dye make [hl|6].
[li] [icon:right_click] Right-click a face with any block to disguise that side.

es_es.title: Vidrio de un solo sentido
es_es.subtitle: Una ventana secreta, muy educada.
text: [lead] Transparente de un lado, sólido del otro.
[li] [item:glassential:one_way_glass|Vidrio de un solo sentido]: seis cristales, un observador y un tinte negro dan [hl|6].
[li] [icon:right_click] Clic derecho sobre una cara con cualquier bloque disfraza ese lado.

en_us.title: Smart Glass
en_us.subtitle: Privacy on a redstone timer.
text: [lead] Frosts over while redstone powers it, and light still gets through.
[li] [item:glassential:smart_glass|Smart Glass]: six glass, two redstone and an amethyst shard make [hl|6].
[li] One signal frosts the whole connected panel.

es_es.title: Vidrio inteligente
es_es.subtitle: Privacidad con temporizador de redstone.
text: [lead] Se empaña mientras la redstone lo alimenta, y la luz pasa igual.
[li] [item:glassential:smart_glass|Vidrio inteligente]: seis cristales, dos redstone y un fragmento de amatista dan [hl|6].
[li] Una sola señal empaña todo el panel conectado.

en_us.title: The Glassential Brush
en_us.subtitle: One pane, your rules.
text: [lead] Choose a color and what the glass does.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_painter|Glassential Brush]: red, green and blue dye, a stick and quartz.
[li] Set the color, whether it emits light or a signal, and whether players or all entities pass.
[li] Sneak-right-click any block to copy its color into the brush.

es_es.title: El pincel de Glassential
es_es.subtitle: Un vidrio, tus reglas.
text: [lead] Elegí un color y qué hace el vidrio.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_painter|Pincel de Glassential]: tinte rojo, verde y azul, un palo y cuarzo.
[li] Fijá el color, si emite luz o señal, y si pasan los jugadores o todas las entidades.
[li] Clic derecho agachado sobre cualquier bloque copia su color al pincel.

en_us.title: Glass with a Job
en_us.subtitle: Blast-proof, ice-cold, feather-soft.
text: [lead] Four more glasses for four more problems.
[li] [item:glassential:obsidian_glass|Obsidian Glass]: four obsidian and four glass make [hl|4]; resistant to explosions.
[li] [item:glassential:ice_glass|Ice Glass]: eight glass around ice; the ice inside does not melt.
{page}
[li] [item:glassential:gravity_glass|Gravity Glass]: eight iron glass around a cobweb; it softens a fall and has no collision.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_lava_lamp|Lava Lamp]: eight glass around a lava bucket; a natural lantern that burns like magma.

es_es.title: Vidrio con un oficio
es_es.subtitle: A prueba de explosiones, helado, blando como pluma.
text: [lead] Cuatro vidrios más para cuatro problemas más.
[li] [item:glassential:obsidian_glass|Cristal de obsidiana]: cuatro obsidianas y cuatro cristales dan [hl|4]; resiste explosiones.
[li] [item:glassential:ice_glass|Vidrio de hielo]: ocho cristales alrededor de hielo; el hielo de adentro no se derrite.
{page}
[li] [item:glassential:gravity_glass|Vidrio de gravedad]: ocho vidrios de hierro alrededor de una telaraña; amortigua la caída y no tiene colisión.
[li] [item:glassential:glass_lava_lamp|Lámpara de lava de vidrio]: ocho cristales alrededor de un balde de lava; una linterna natural que quema como magma.

en_us.title: Supplementaries: Keep and Show
en_us.subtitle: Every shelf deserves a small mob.
text: [lead] Blocks that hold things and show them off.
[li] [item:supplementaries:jar|Jar]: seven glass and a slab; holds bowls, bottles, buckets, cookies and small mobs.
[li] [item:supplementaries:sack|Sack]: seven flax and a string; quite heavy to carry.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:item_shelf|Item Shelf]: three slabs make [hl|2]; [item:supplementaries:pedestal|Pedestal] and [item:supplementaries:hat_stand|Hat Stand] show items and armor.
[li] [item:supplementaries:notice_board|Notice Board]: pins a book or a map for everyone.

es_es.title: Supplementaries: guardar y lucir
es_es.subtitle: Cada estante merece un mob chiquito.
text: [lead] Bloques que guardan cosas y las lucen.
[li] [item:supplementaries:jar|Tarro de cristal]: siete cristales y una losa; guarda cuencos, botellas, baldes, galletas y mobs chicos.
[li] [item:supplementaries:sack|Saco]: siete de lino y un hilo; bastante pesado para cargar.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:item_shelf|Estantería]: tres losas dan [hl|2]; [item:supplementaries:pedestal|Pedestal] y [item:supplementaries:hat_stand|Perchero de sombreros] exhiben ítems y armaduras.
[li] [item:supplementaries:notice_board|Rótulo]: prende un libro o un mapa para todos.

en_us.title: Flags, Awnings and Buntings
en_us.subtitle: The block party, in cloth.
text: [lead] Cloth for the street: flags, awnings and buntings on ropes.
[li] [item:supplementaries:flag_white|White Flag]: six white wool and a rod; sixteen colors.
[li] [item:supplementaries:awning|Awning]: three flax and two rods make [hl|2].
[li] Buntings hang from [item:supplementaries:rope|Rope]: [hl|3] flax make [hl|3] ropes.
{page}
[note] Flower boxes hold any big plant; doormats take a message.
[li] [item:supplementaries:sconce|Sconce]: three iron nuggets and a torch.
[li] [item:supplementaries:candle_holder|Candle Holder]: a candle over an iron ingot; they stack, in sixteen dyes.

es_es.title: Banderas, toldos y guirnaldas
es_es.subtitle: La fiesta de la cuadra, en tela.
text: [lead] Tela para la calle: banderas, toldos y guirnaldas en sogas.
[li] [item:supplementaries:flag_white|Bandera blanca]: seis lanas blancas y una vara; dieciséis colores.
[li] [item:supplementaries:awning|Toldo]: tres de lino y dos varas dan [hl|2].
[li] Las guirnaldas cuelgan de la [item:supplementaries:rope|Cuerda]: [hl|3] de lino dan [hl|3] sogas.
{page}
[note] Los maceteros aceptan cualquier planta grande; los felpudos, un mensaje.
[li] [item:supplementaries:sconce|Aplique]: tres pepitas de hierro y una antorcha.
[li] [item:supplementaries:candle_holder|Portavelas]: una vela sobre un lingote de hierro; se apilan, en dieciséis tintes.

en_us.title: Timber Frames
en_us.subtitle: Half-timbered in a hurry.
text: [lead] A frame that takes any full block: half-timbered walls in a click.
[li] [item:supplementaries:timber_frame|Timber Frame]: four rods make [hl|1].
[li] Add braces and cross-braces for the diagonals.
[li] [item:supplementaries:daub|Daub]: clay and straw fill the gaps, [hl|2] at a time.

es_es.title: Entramados de madera
es_es.subtitle: Entramado en un ratito.
text: [lead] Un marco que acepta cualquier bloque completo: paredes entramadas en un clic.
[li] [item:supplementaries:timber_frame|Armazón]: cuatro varas dan [hl|1].
[li] Sumá riostras y cruces para las diagonales.
[li] [item:supplementaries:daub|Quincha]: arcilla y paja rellenan los huecos, de a [hl|2].

en_us.title: Blackboards and Signs
en_us.subtitle: Write on the walls. Legally.
text: [lead] A wall you can draw on, and signs that point somewhere.
[li] [item:supplementaries:blackboard|Blackboard]: opens an editor with clear and undo.
[li] [item:supplementaries:way_sign_oak|Oak Way Sign]: an oak sign makes [hl|2]; it points to a place, with the distance.
[li] [item:supplementaries:globe|Globe]: a spinning map of the world, sold by the Wandering Trader.

es_es.title: Pizarras y carteles
es_es.subtitle: Escribí en las paredes. Con permiso.
text: [lead] Una pared para dibujar y carteles que señalan algo.
[li] [item:supplementaries:blackboard|Encerado]: abre un editor con borrar y deshacer.
[li] [item:supplementaries:way_sign_oak|Cartel indicador de roble]: un cartel de roble da [hl|2]; señala un lugar, con la distancia.
[li] [item:supplementaries:globe|Globo terráqueo]: un mapa del mundo que gira, lo vende el Comerciante Errante.

en_us.title: Supplementaries: Gadgets
en_us.subtitle: Redstone with better manners.
text: [lead] Small machines for the street: timers, weather vanes and locks.
[li] [item:supplementaries:hourglass|Hourglass]: five glass and two gold ingots; accepts any dust, sand or powder.
[li] [item:supplementaries:wind_vane|Wind Vane]: reacts to the weather.
[li] [item:supplementaries:turn_table|Turn Table]: turns the block on top.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:lock_block|Lock Block] and [item:supplementaries:key|Key]: a locked door or hatch opens only to its key.

es_es.title: Supplementaries: aparatos
es_es.subtitle: Redstone con mejores modales.
text: [lead] Máquinas chicas para la calle: temporizadores, veletas y cerraduras.
[li] [item:supplementaries:hourglass|Reloj de arena]: cinco cristales y dos lingotes de oro; acepta cualquier polvo, arena o pólvora.
[li] [item:supplementaries:wind_vane|Veleta]: reacciona al clima.
[li] [item:supplementaries:turn_table|Mesa giratoria]: gira el bloque de arriba.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:lock_block|Cerrojo] y [item:supplementaries:key|Llave]: una puerta o escotilla trabada sólo abre con su llave.

en_us.title: Supplementaries: Carry Tools
en_us.subtitle: Yes, the cannon. Almost anything.
text: [lead] Gear for the street's less peaceful moments.
[li] [item:supplementaries:quiver|Quiver]: holds arrows; open it with [key:supplementaries.keybind.quiver].
[li] [item:supplementaries:slingshot|Slingshot]: throws blocks and items.
[li] [item:supplementaries:cannon|Cannon]: fires almost anything.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:cage|Cage]: catches small or tamed animals; [item:supplementaries:present|Present] wraps items for a player.
[li] [item:supplementaries:lunch_basket|Lunch Basket]: carries food, and switches between open and closed.

es_es.title: Supplementaries: herramientas de mano
es_es.subtitle: Sí, el cañón. Casi cualquier cosa.
text: [lead] Equipo para los momentos menos pacíficos de la calle.
[li] [item:supplementaries:quiver|Carcaj]: guarda flechas; se abre con [key:supplementaries.keybind.quiver].
[li] [item:supplementaries:slingshot|Resortera]: lanza bloques e ítems.
[li] [item:supplementaries:cannon|Cañón]: dispara casi cualquier cosa.
{page}
[li] [item:supplementaries:cage|Jaula]: atrapa animales chicos o domados; [item:supplementaries:present|Regalo] envuelve ítems para un jugador.
[li] [item:supplementaries:lunch_basket|Canasta de almuerzo]: lleva comida, y alterna entre abierta y cerrada.

en_us.title: Amendments: Hung, Not Placed
en_us.subtitle: Vanilla, minus the old annoyances.
text: [lead] Things vanilla only lets you set on the floor now hang.
[li:minecraft:lantern] Lanterns go on walls.
[li] Flower pots hang from ceilings; banners hang from ceilings too.
[li] Tools and other items hang from tripwire hooks; items can sit on hanging signs.
{page}
[note] Amendments is the small mod Supplementaries split off: it changes vanilla instead of adding blocks.
[li] Carpets lie on stairs and slabs and follow their shape.
[li] Skulls stack into piles and take a candle on top.

es_es.title: Amendments: colgar, no apoyar
es_es.subtitle: Vanilla, sin las molestias de siempre.
text: [lead] Lo que vanilla sólo deja en el suelo ahora cuelga.
[li:minecraft:lantern] Los faroles van en las paredes.
[li] Las macetas cuelgan de los techos; los estandartes también.
[li] Las herramientas y otros ítems cuelgan de ganchos de cuerda trampa; los ítems pueden apoyarse en carteles colgantes.
{page}
[note] Amendments es el mod chico que Supplementaries separó: cambia vanilla en vez de sumar bloques.
[li] Las alfombras se apoyan sobre escaleras y losas y siguen su forma.
[li] Los cráneos se apilan y llevan una vela encima.

en_us.title: The Enhanced Cauldron
en_us.subtitle: It mixes now. Keep it away from your good robe.
text: [lead] Dye water, mix potions and craft from a cauldron.
[li] Dye the water any color, and mix dyes.
[li] Mix potions in one cauldron, up to a limit of effects.
[li] Craft by clicking on it, or by throwing items in.
[note] A potion mix that looks unstable warns you first.

es_es.title: El caldero mejorado
es_es.subtitle: Ahora mezcla. Alejalo de tu túnica buena.
text: [lead] Teñí agua, mezclá pociones y fabricá desde un caldero.
[li] Teñí el agua de cualquier color y mezclá tintes.
[li] Mezclá pociones en un caldero, hasta un límite de efectos.
[li] Fabricá haciendo clic sobre él, o tirándole ítems adentro.
[note] Una mezcla de pociones inestable te avisa antes.

en_us.title: Quirk: cake bites count
text: [lead] A bite of an Amendments cake still counts for satiety overflow.
Cakes can be eaten from any side, and two stack into a double cake.
Food eaten from a block, like a cake or a Farmer's Delight pie, is measured like food from your hand.
How the surplus turns into buffs: [quest:farming_satiety_surplus|Satiety].

es_es.title: Rareza: los bocados de torta cuentan
text: [lead] Un bocado de una torta de Amendments igual cuenta para el desborde de saciedad.
Las tortas se comen desde cualquier lado, y dos se apilan en una torta doble.
La comida que se come de un bloque, como una torta o una tarta de Farmer's Delight, se mide igual que la de tu mano.
Cómo el excedente se vuelve mejoras: [quest:farming_satiety_surplus|Saciedad].

en_us.title: You spin me right round
en_us.subtitle: The world, at ludicrous speed.
text: [lead] You spun a [item:supplementaries:globe|Globe] until it blurred.
The Wandering Trader sells them, and no one is sure why the trader carries a world around.

es_es.title: Girando, girando
es_es.subtitle: El mundo, a una velocidad ridícula.
text: [lead] Hiciste girar un [item:supplementaries:globe|Globo terráqueo] hasta que se desdibujó.
Los vende el Comerciante Errante, y nadie sabe por qué lleva un mundo encima.

en_us.title: How the turn tables
en_us.subtitle: Vertigo, but on purpose.
text: [lead] You rode a [item:supplementaries:turn_table|Turn Table] and turned with it.
Some carousels start as a wooden block and a bad idea.

es_es.title: Cómo giran las mesas
es_es.subtitle: Mareo, pero a propósito.
text: [lead] Te subiste a una [item:supplementaries:turn_table|Mesa giratoria] y giraste con ella.
Algunos carruseles empiezan como un bloque de madera y una mala idea.

en_us.title: Tide pod challenge
en_us.subtitle: Squeaky clean, from the inside.
text: [lead] You ate a bar of [item:supplementaries:soap|Soap].
[careful] Not a food. Six bars come from a water bucket, four ash and a porkchop, and they are meant for glass and blocks.

es_es.title: Desafío del jabón
es_es.subtitle: Impecable, por dentro.
text: [lead] Te comiste una barra de [item:supplementaries:soap|Jabón].
[careful] No es comida. Seis barras salen de un balde de agua, cuatro cenizas y una chuleta, y son para vidrios y bloques.

en_us.title: Angry birds
en_us.subtitle: The parrot did not consent.
text: [lead] You tossed a parrot with a [item:supplementaries:slingshot|Slingshot].
It flew, if you call that flying.

es_es.title: Pájaros furiosos
es_es.subtitle: El loro no dio su consentimiento.
text: [lead] Lanzaste un loro con una [item:supplementaries:slingshot|Resortera].
Voló, si a eso se le puede llamar volar.

en_us.title: A wall with a secret
en_us.subtitle: It looks like a wall. It is not.
text: [lead] You built a [item:framedblocks:framed_secret_storage|Framed Secret Storage].
A [item:framedblocks:framed_chest|Framed Chest] in a ring of four framed cubes, dressed in the block you chose.

es_es.title: Una pared con secreto
es_es.subtitle: Parece una pared. No lo es.
text: [lead] Armaste un [item:framedblocks:framed_secret_storage|Almacén secreto enmarcado].
Un [item:framedblocks:framed_chest|Cofre enmarcado] en un anillo de cuatro cubos enmarcados, vestido con el bloque que elegiste.

en_us.title: Planks for the scaffolding
en_us.subtitle: Somebody always needs one more board.
text: [lead] For the common store, once a day.
[big|64] planks of any wood.
Every street starts with scaffolding, and scaffolding starts with someone else's spare boards.

es_es.title: Tablones para el andamio
es_es.subtitle: Siempre falta una tabla más.
text: [lead] Para el depósito común, una vez por día.
[big|64] tablones de cualquier madera.
Toda calle empieza con andamios, y los andamios empiezan con las tablas que le sobran a otro.

en_us.title: The Street Is Alive
en_us.subtitle: Lights on, sign up, somebody home.
text: [lead] Four lamps and a sign: the street has a name and does not go dark.
[li] [big|4] [item:mcwlights:classic_street_lamp|Street Lamp Post], one per corner.
[li] A [item:supplementaries:way_sign_oak|Oak Way Sign] at the crossing.
{page}
Everything in this street was optional except the way from the first bench to the last lamp. Yours will not look like anyone else's.

es_es.title: La calle está viva
es_es.subtitle: Luces prendidas, cartel puesto, alguien en casa.
text: [lead] Cuatro farolas y un cartel: la calle tiene nombre y no se queda a oscuras.
[li] [big|4] [item:mcwlights:classic_street_lamp|Farola clásica], una por esquina.
[li] Un [item:supplementaries:way_sign_oak|Cartel indicador de roble] en la encrucijada.
{page}
Todo en esta calle era opcional menos el camino del primer banco a la última farola. La tuya no se va a parecer a ninguna otra.

en_us.title: Flip the switch
en_us.subtitle: Every lamp on the block.
text: [lead] The lamplighter retires: one switch does the whole street.
Nothing to build. Just the click.

es_es.title: Apretá el interruptor
es_es.subtitle: Todas las lámparas de la cuadra.
text: [lead] El farolero se jubila: un interruptor hace toda la calle.
No hay nada que construir. Sólo el clic.

en_us.title: Fly the flag
en_us.subtitle: Whose, exactly, is up to you.
text: [lead] A flag on the roof, because a finished building deserves one.
Nothing to build. Just a wave.

es_es.title: Izá la bandera
es_es.subtitle: De quién, exactamente, lo decidís vos.
text: [lead] Una bandera en el techo, porque un edificio terminado se la merece.
No hay nada que construir. Sólo un saludo.
